When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.

Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.

Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.

When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat.

Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.

1558-5775-6741.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five multicolored permanents plus either another multicolored permanent or another creature with power 2 or greater.

Declare Fortune as an attacker. At end of combat, it triggers, blinking it and Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

Play the land from your graveyard.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.
